ov: A small freshwater carp native to China, first bred for colour there over 1,000 years ago and now one of the most popular aquarium fish. Goldfish released into the wild have become pests in parts of North America and Australia.

why.p: One of the most popular aquarium fish, commonly kept in indoor tanks.

len: Usually about 20 cm; up to 45 cm
rg: Native to China; kept worldwide, and established in the wild in places.
fx: Under the Song dynasty, only the imperial family could keep yellow goldfish, since yellow was the imperial colour.
